svg.title: Business audit: the change and its record in one commit, a refused attempt recorded apart

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An audit trail is not a log

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A log helps an operator find a fault. An audit trail answers a question somebody will ask in a year: who did this?

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHO DID WHAT, FROM WHAT TO WHAT

svg.text: The change and its audit record are saved

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: together. Rolled back, neither exists: the trail

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: never claims a change that did not happen.

svg.text: The refusal is recorded on a connection of its

svg.text: own, so it survives the rollback: what somebody

svg.text: tried is often what a reviewer wants to know.

svg.text: The actor is never a header

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It comes from the validated token. Queued work

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: runs as a named actor: system:ReserveStock.
